تحتملن (form VIII)
# تَحْتَمِلْنَ (taḥtamilna) /taħ.ta.mil.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
# تُحْتَمَلْنَ (tuḥtamalna) /tuħ.ta.mal.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
